doc.title: Don Alias interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 6, 2002

title: Thanks and closing
summary: Rowe thanks Alias; Alias says he rarely gets to express himself like this.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing thanks and goodbyes at the end of the interview

blocks.x: Yeah. Well listen, this has really been absolutely fascinating. I want to thank you so much for sharing this time with me. It was everything I expected.

I’ll tell you man, you know, there’s guys in this music business that are superstars and they do this kind of thing like a lot of times, you know, Sanborn and Herbie, I don’t. I don’t talk. I don’t really talk. I don’t have the opportunity to express myself like this. I can’t tell you what it means to me.
Excellent. It’s been a great experience for me. All right?
We made it, didn’t we? © Hamilton College Jazz Archive -22-
